refund-window.answer: Customers may request a refund within 30 days of purchase; after that only service credits apply.

sla-uptime.answer: The production SLA targets 99.9% monthly availability. Credits are given when availability drops below 99.0%.

data-retention.answer: We keep customer data for 24 months, unless the customer asks to delete it sooner. This is not legal advice.

security-incident.answer: Security incidents are acknowledged within 1 hour and customers are notified within 72 hours.

pii-handling.answer: Customer PII must not be stored outside the ticketing system. This is not legal advice.

pricing-change.answer: Prices may change with 30 days prior notice.

support-escalation.answer: A support ticket is escalated to a senior engineer after more than 8 hours without resolution.

account-deletion.answer: Account deletion is finished within 5 business days and cannot be undone.
